name: Miyasumi Misato
source:
Misato is the president of the broadcasting club. Her adaptation exam score is never revealed, but [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url] does note that she is engaging in severe self-destructive behavior from time to time, which would put her at least above 30%. She refers to Taichi as "Peke-kun". Her brother [url=https://vndb.org/c3665]Tomoki[/url] is in a cold war with her and their parents have separated. Tomoki lives with their mother and Misato is living with their father.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
